state.request: Build an autonomous software factory into the existing Taskboard plugin, inspired by https://github.com/lpbaril/bb-plugin-factory. Make Linear, Jira, or the configured issue provider the source of truth. The factory should continuously select eligible tickets, start and supervise BB agent work, avoid duplicate dispatch, recover after restart, and reflect progress back through the existing Taskboard provider/status model. Reuse the current taskboard architecture and keep the first implementation focused and operable.
state.message: Added explicit project AI selection to the factory contract: persisted provider, model, reasoning, permission mode and service tier; explicit-input dispatch with native-default fallback; actionable missing-configuration failure; Project Manage AI controls; focused verification.

lifecycle.riskRequest: Let users choose which AI (provider and model, plus reasoning, permission mode, and service tier) the Taskboard factory uses for its coordinator and stage sessions. Persist the choice in the project factory policy, expose it in project Manage and the CLI, and use it for manual Start task and automatic intake, falling back to the project native execution defaults only when no explicit choice exists. Today Start task from Taskboard fails with 'Choose native BB model and execution settings for this project first' when a project has no defaults and offers no way to choose.
